scope: Existing local portal, normal/hover/selected/focus, catalog no results/reset, popup and page chat, source expansion, validation, controlled loading/error, six open price terms; all seven PDF pages. No external model, auth or production.

text_web.review: Only low measurement is inactive Tøm chat during loading; disabled action blocked by native disabled. Busy/status text passes. No exemption used for status/error text.

pdf_text.result: No text contrast finding; all conservatively checked at 4.5:1, including footer/diagram text. Intended source fills, not antialiased edges, used for foreground.

nontext.result: No below-3 finding for sampled field borders on inner/outer backgrounds, needed close icon, other sampled icons and focus outline. Not complete semantic classification of all graphic parts.

pdf_graphics_review: Seven fresh renderings reviewed: page-3 icons repeat named headings; page-7 coloured bullets accompany explicit text. Koala, page rules and card strips are decorative. Page-6 ellipse borders are weak compared with pale surroundings but labels/paragraph spacing and central dark node remain visible; full classification of necessary spatial graphic relationships remains U under 1.4.11/1.1.1, rather than an invented blanket exemption. No confirmed graphic-contrast breach declared from this preliminary classification.
limits: 1.4.3 K applies to stated existing local representative sample and carried normal-state evidence; no formal global conformance.
1.4.11 remains U for full classification of necessary graphics/states.
No actual held pointer-down/active capture; ripple source/DOM shows disabled and no custom :active colour found.
Controlled loading/error fixture tests rendered existing UI, not actual network outage/model generation.
No screen reader, actual 200/400% zoom, physical device, OS preferences, authentication or production validation.
